snippet.title: Pup Champs - Thinky Direct trailer
snippet.description:
Out now on Steam, App Store & Google Play: https://afterburn.games/pup

Pup Champs, our tactical puzzle game about playing soccer just got bigger! 15+ new puzzles, a story epilogue, bug fixes and more - all available for free in the first content update!
